findings.sourceQuote: Oliver Sacks, in his paper The President's Speech, indicated how people who are unable to understand speech because of brain damage are nevertheless able to assess sincerity accurately.
findings.targetQuote: 奥利弗·萨克斯及其论文指出，总统的演讲表明，那些因脑损伤而无法理解言语的人，仍然能够准确地评估真诚度。
